blocks.text: Transcription bubble ke andar RNA polymerase template DNA strand ke saamne complementary ribonucleotides ki zanjeer banana shuru karta hai. Yeh 5′ se 3′ ki simt mein hota hai aur aam taur par A ya G ribonucleotide se shuru hota hai. Yahan jurne wale nucleotides ribonucleoside triphosphates (rNTP) ki shakal mein hote hain. Jab rNTP jurta hai to us ke do phosphate energy chhorte hue alag ho jate hain aur ribonucleotide zanjeer se jur jata hai.

Naye mRNA ke pehle 12 bases template DNA ke saath aik aarzi (temporary) helix banate hain. Is se mRNA ka 3′ sira apni jagah tikka rehta hai aur agla ribonucleotide le sakta hai. Har nucleotide jurne par RNA-DNA helix ghoomta hai, is liye RNA ka 3′ sira RNA polymerase ki catalytic site (kaam wali jagah) par hi rehta hai. Transcription bubble DNA par aage barhta hai, barhta hua mRNA bubble se bahar nikalta hai, aur bubble guzarne ke baad transcribe hua DNA dobara lipat jata hai.

blocks.alt: Gulabi RNA polymerase ke andar transcription bubble. Aage DNA khul raha (unwinding) aur peeche dobara lipat raha (rewinding) hai. Coding strand (peela) oopar se guzarta hai; template strand (neela) ke saath naya mRNA (narangi) chhota DNA-RNA hybrid helix banata hai, us ka 3' sira barhta aur 5' sira bahar nikalta hai. rNTPs andar aate hain; hara teer harkat ki simt.
